title: Provider Rejections on Mobile Wallet Credits: Automatic Re-sends and Attribution
content:
Payments operations note on how **Mobile Wallet** credits that a wallet provider cannot complete are re-sent automatically, and on whose side each rejection reason lies.

## Automatic re-sends by tier

A credit that fails for a technical provider reason is re-sent automatically before it is treated as failed.

| Tier | Automatic re-sends | Minutes between re-sends |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 3 | 30 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 3 | 30 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 3 | 15 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 4 | 15 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 6 | 10 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 3 | 30 |

## Attribution of each rejection reason (every tier)

Each provider rejection reason is attributed either to the recipient's side (a sender-side failure) or to Paloma's or the provider's side. The attribution is the same on all six Mobile Wallet tiers.

| Rejection reason shown on the reversed credit | Attributed to |
|---|---|
| wallet limit exceeded | recipient's side (sender) |
| wallet not registered | recipient's side (sender) |
| wallet name mismatch | recipient's side (sender) |
| wallet number invalid | recipient's side (sender) |
| wallet suspended | recipient's side (sender) |
| provider unavailable | Paloma's or the provider's side |

*Hypothetical reading:* on Mobile Wallet Priority a credit the provider cannot complete because it is unavailable is re-sent up to 6 times, 10 minutes apart; a credit rejected because the wallet is suspended is a recipient-side failure.
